name: LPIC-1 System Administrator (Exam 101-500)
description: Linux Professional Institute LPIC-1, first of the two exams (101-500). Validates the ability to perform maintenance tasks on the command line, install and configure a Linux system, and configure basic networking. Covers system architecture, Linux installation and package management, GNU and Unix commands, and devices, Linux filesystems and the Filesystem Hierarchy Standard. 60 questions, 90 minutes, passing score 500/800.
exportIntroQuestions:
## About this document

This document is a collection of practice exam questions for the **LPIC-1 System Administrator (Exam 101-500)** certification.

### Certification context

The exam validates hands-on Linux administration on the command line: boot process and hardware, package management (dpkg/apt and rpm/yum/dnf), text processing with GNU tools, processes, filesystems, permissions and the FHS.

### About the questions

Each question is independent and should be analyzed as a standalone scenario.

domains.name: System Architecture
domains.description: Topic 101: determine and configure hardware settings, boot the system, change runlevels/boot targets and shutdown or reboot the system.

domains.name: Linux Installation and Package Management
domains.description: Topic 102: design hard disk layout, install a boot manager, manage shared libraries, Debian and RPM/YUM package management, Linux as a virtualization guest.

domains.name: GNU and Unix Commands
domains.description: Topic 103: work on the command line, process text streams with filters, file management, streams/pipes/redirects, processes, priorities, regular expressions, vi.

domains.name: Devices, Linux Filesystems, Filesystem Hierarchy Standard
domains.description: Topic 104: partitions and filesystems, filesystem integrity, mounting, permissions and ownership, hard and symbolic links, finding system files and the FHS.
